record.title: Validate a bounded APK-backed bandwidth reader offline
record.intent: Reuse established mapping checks while narrowing observations to two four-byte bandwidth fields.
requirements: Create a separate reader build restricted to the pinned bandwidth fields twice, at most16 target bytes through one readonly descriptor. Retain PID, starttime, boot, APK, ELF, file and mapping checks; no target calls, attachment or writes.

Preserve prior reader and evidence. Run host mapping and rejection controls plus a disposable loopback-only Android fixture with distinct values in the two fields, exact read counts and negative cases before memory access.
Verify repeated samples, mapping address arithmetic, guest health and unchanged guest policy independently; seal evidence and commit/push conclusions.
Do not contact the physical specimen in this task.
acceptance: The narrow reader passes independent controls or its exact failure is preserved.
